apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art life sim inspired by traditional Chinese medicine. Grow medicinal herbs, examine symptoms, read the pulse, diagnose patterns, craft remedies, and care for a village through four seasons and the twenty-four solar terms.

apps.name: Aboard the Deviant
apps.short_description: A NSFW, sex-and-inflation visual novel. When Dell and Rio are rescued by kinky aliens, they begin to experience pleasures they'd never thought possible. Trapped in a perverted gameshow, will they accept their new lives, or try to get home?

apps.name: ACROFLOW
apps.short_description: Dive through dimensions with style in this 3D expressive platformer! Join Acro and Flora on their cosmic quest to reunite and return home. Use their acrobatic abilities to jump, dive and spin through bite-sized arcade platforming challenges set across multiple dream-like realms!

apps.name: AFK Throne
apps.short_description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them. With luck, you'll find rare tradable items to sell on the Steam Community Market.

apps.name: AIRSKIPPER
apps.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

apps.name: Anticitizen: Red
apps.short_description: In an American occupied cyberpunk Australia; use bullet time, a whole bunch of weapons and movement mechanics to outwit biker gangs and face off the corporate police. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, explore the new American empire, stay for the larrikin charm.

apps.name: Apocalipsis Pelucho
apps.short_description: The plushies have gone mad with hunger and rage. In this classic-style FPS, take control of Oslo the Brave Dog, and put a stop to their chaos as you face hordes of cute animals, equipped with a steady hand and an arsenal of strange contraptions.

apps.name: Apprentice: Tidy Up The Viking Village!
apps.short_description: After a successful raid, the Vikings brought back more than just loot, they brought chaos! Weapons and shields are scattered in the armory, and the tavern is full of bottles and jugs left over from celebrations. While everyone rests, it's up to you to restore order by sorting 4000+ items!

apps.name: Arcane Hunter
apps.short_description: Find, track and hunt the supernatural creatures that haunt a modern-day wilderness. Read tracks and essence trails, load your silver rounds, and take your shot with real ballistics, on contracts from the locals who need your help.

apps.name: Armada Breaker
apps.short_description: A hand-painted vertical shoot-'em-up. Break a living armada across three acts: five commanders, five colossal Titans and a gate no one has passed. Bosses learn how you beat them. Then face the Reckoning, where the wrecks rebuild themselves, and an endless Abyss.

apps.name: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
apps.short_description:
A cozy first-person sorting game. Three thousand weapons lie in a heap across a two-floor medieval armoury, and every
one has exactly one right place. Learn the hall, earn the skills that reveal it, and set it all right before dawn — alone or
with friends.

apps.name: Autobrawl Arena
apps.short_description: BUILD A TEAM of autonomous nanobots from countless parts. COMBINE DNA to arm them with hybrid bioweapons. WATCH THEM FIGHT FOR YOU against rival teams in an ever-changing microscopic arena. Sign sponsors, defend towers, place bets, and win the grand tournament!

apps.name: Averlyn
apps.short_description: Build a home, grow a community, and explore a world full of adventure in this cozy third-person life and adventure game. Farm, customize, explore, battle, and create your own story in Averlyn.

apps.name: Backyard Volley
apps.short_description: Backyard Volley is a first-person volleyball game where your mouse is your arm. Flick to spike, tip, bump, set, block and serve. Play 2v2 or 3v3 online with friends, let bots fill the empty seats, and watch every point back in an instant replay!

apps.name: Balseo: The Sea Beyond
apps.short_description: BALSEO is a dark odyssey across a mythological archipelago. Venture into the fog, master stealth, and strike pacts with witchcraft in an adventure blending psychological and folk horror.

apps.name: Bayaya
apps.short_description: A story-driven fairytale adventure about Prince Bayaya. Explore village life, help with simple work, and experience the beginning of a larger fairytale journey.

apps.name: Beautiful Life Show
apps.short_description: Welcome to the deadly stage of The Beautiful Life Show　a side-scrolling horror action adventure. As the star of a bizarre performance, you face fatal trials. Rewind time 3 seconds before death and collaborate with your replay ghost. Will you survive to witness what lies beyond the abyss?

apps.name: Beholder 4
apps.short_description: Beholder 4 returns to a totalitarian State where your choices matter. Live a double life as an official and underground agent. Spy, sabotage, build relationships, and decide others' fates. But brace for a knock: the police are coming, and your home is full of evidence.

apps.name: Big Bad Wool
apps.short_description: Wolves in sheep's clothing versus watchful shepherds. Blend into the flock, fool your friends or spot the impostors. BigBadWool is an asymmetric hide-and-seek game for 2–6 players online, with bot practice to learn both sides.

apps.name: Bird Them Up
apps.short_description: Battle hordes of mutant insects solo or with friends in online co-op in a chaotic roguelike survivor with bullet-hell action. Combine weapons and perks, complete missions, and create devastating builds. Stop the bug-pocalypse!

apps.name: Blacksmithkin
apps.short_description: Forge swords, shields and armor in hands-on minigames. Equip your customers, watch them duel in the town square, then enter the arena yourself. Upgrade your workshop and face tougher enemies in Blacksmithkin, a first-person medieval blacksmith game.

apps.name: Bookshelves
apps.short_description: A cozy board game for you and your friends. Draft books from library carts, line them up by genre and fill your shelf for points. Up to 4 players online, with bots for the empty seats, plus a fresh Daily Curate puzzle every day.

apps.name: Boops & Baps
apps.short_description: Embark on an epic journey to save your furry friends from disaster! Pick your dog or cat, rally the pack and charge into co-op mayhem, loaded up with ridiculous weapons and facing the nastiest humans around. Play solo or with up to seven friends.

apps.name: Bring It
apps.short_description: A stylized retro arcade game about a motor courier hustling through the city to deliver meals, coffee and groceries with skill and style. Chain boosts, drifts, air dashes and double jumps, then spend your earnings on home upgrades,new licenses and bikes with unique abilities for the next day’s rush.

apps.name: Bubble Boom 2000
apps.short_description: BUBBLE BOOM 2000 is a Top Down Shooter inspired by popular 2000s and early 2010s aesthetics, packaged in an experience that makes you feel like you're back in a 90s arcade. Play as bright and bubbly characters across different maps and pop all of your foes.

apps.name: Bunkum
apps.short_description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

apps.name: cactus rush
apps.short_description: cactus rush is a First Person PVP-platformer-hybrid where you place cacti beneath your balloon-like opponents to pop them. It requires fast-paced navigation, strategical positioning, and unique mechanics to maneuver your way to victory!

apps.name: Call the Ambulance
apps.short_description: The world's least qualified paramedics – now hiring 1-4 players. Answer the call, botch the treatment, and survive scenes no textbook prepared you for, from suburban living rooms to full-on bank heists. Chaotic co-op comedy, ambulance included.

apps.name: Castle-O
apps.short_description: Navigate the castle gardens, find the fastest route and compete for the best time.

apps.name: Cat Stack
apps.short_description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

apps.name: Ceti Break
apps.short_description: Your cursor is you. Dodge and lunge as you attack and evade at the speed and accuracy of your mouse control. Fill out the skill tree for buffs and bonuses to help you survive the waves that grow in number and strength.

apps.name: Choice of Life: Become a Witch
apps.short_description: Leka has always dreamed of becoming a witch. But the real magical world turned out not to be what she had imagined. Will she be able to uncover all its secrets? Including the one that connects her to magic.

apps.name: Christmas TCG Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: Tidy up nearly 5,000 festive trading cards scattered across the floor of a Christmas TCG store, solo or with up to two friends online. Clean your finds and complete 15 festive sets in regular and holo finishes. Earn coins for boosters packs, hunt for exclusive rare cards.

apps.name: Cluepuff Adventures
apps.short_description: A cozy puzzle adventure across floating puzzle dimensions, with Cluepuff, a curious little companion you can talk to. Flip gravity, ride arks, open gates and find every puzzle piece, then build your own levels and share them with the Community.

apps.name: COLDFILE
apps.short_description: A tactical third-person stealth game, solo or in online co-op. Hide in the shadows, move quietly and outsmart guards who see and hear you. Climb, take cover, grab and interrogate enemies, and choose for yourself whether to kill, knock out or slip past them unseen.

apps.name: Commando Squad
apps.short_description: Lead four elite commandos behind enemy lines in 100 tactical stealth missions. Study patrols, slip past searchlights, take guards down silently and get the whole squad out alive. A classic squad-stealth tactics game, rebuilt for today.

apps.name: Company of Heroes: Europe in Ruins
apps.short_description: Europe In Ruins is a persistent warfare mod for Company of Heroes. Every battle matters: surviving units gain veterancy, losses are permanent, and every battle leaves its mark. Choose a doctrine, build your company, and lead your troops across an ongoing campaign.

apps.name: Cozy Beach
apps.short_description: 🏝️ Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an beautiful tropical island where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, go swimming, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

apps.name: Cozy Shores
apps.short_description: You find yourself stranded on an abandoned island with your beloved cat. Clean the island, recycle all the trash, build a bond with your pet and create a cozy paradise.

apps.name: Crack & Stack
apps.short_description: Race up to six friends to stack dice and crack puzzles in this chaotic party game! Based on the 2025 board game, Crack & Stack, you can now play online, split-screen, or solo against the commentary team, and turn on Chaos Mode for rounds that bend all the rules!

apps.name: Crack a Pack
apps.short_description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

apps.name: Crash Sequence
apps.short_description: Crash-landed alone on an alien world, you survive by sequencing alien bacteria, building custom plasmids, and engineering living cultures for oxygen, food and power. A turn-based sci-fi RPG / strategy simulation where your choices shape how the story ends.

apps.name: Crashborn
apps.short_description: Lost and with no memories, cross a solar system to get back home. Tear through each planet's hordes to recharge your ship's energy and take off before the world turns lethal. Combine weapons, implants and anomalies until nothing can stop you. Every death rewrites your reality and your memory.

apps.name: Crewcial
apps.short_description: History's worst repair crew, unstuck in space-time. 1-4 players, couch or online: land somewhere new, grab the tools, fix what's broken, yell at each other. No world is safe. Local and online co-op. The timeline may not survive you.

apps.name: Crude Intention
apps.short_description: The oil boom is on, and fuel is gold. Drive, drift, and smash your way through the 15 named beasts that own the land of the biggest hidden oil fields to get filthy rich.

apps.name: Cthuloop
apps.short_description:
Dive into madness in CTHULOOP, a 1st-person cosmic horror adventure game. Trapped in a loop, you must observe eerie anomalies and piece together cryptic clues before your sanity fractures completely. Can you escape, or will you loop forever?

Developed for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam (theme: "Loop").

apps.name: CURSOR SLASH
apps.short_description: A pixel-art incremental game where your mouse cursor attacks automatically! Slaughter slimes to earn gold and collect ores such as copper, iron, and gold. Unlock a variety of skills, weapons, relics, and coins, then sweep away hordes of slimes!

apps.name: Daimyo Reign
apps.short_description: Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!

apps.name: Darkest Discoveries
apps.short_description: Darkest Discoveries is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Stop demons & creatures before they catch you. Run, hide, scream, but do NOT get caught.

apps.name: Darklight Breach
apps.short_description: FTL meets XCOM in a real-time tactical roguelite about breaching alien ships. Flank through rooms, disable systems, outmaneuver defenders, and extract with high-value loot. Fence your haul to power up and break a mysterious time loop.

apps.name: Dead in Space
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder. Race back home to save the world from the Rebel scum. Choose your mech, craft your deck, and charge ahead. Just make sure you don't run out of fuel!

apps.name: Dealer Shift
apps.short_description: Get your hands dirty in an immersive open-world crime simulator. Mix, grind, dissolve, and package every product yourself, build hidden labs, outsmart the police, smuggle shipments through checkpoints, and grow from a small-time dealer into an underground kingpin.

apps.name: Depthline
apps.short_description: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.

apps.name: Deserter
apps.short_description: An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

apps.name: Desk Quest
apps.short_description: Adventurers fall. Their stories remain. Desk Quest is an idle ARPG in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar: while you work, an adventurer fights, loots, makes their own choices and grows, until one day they fall and the next one takes the road.

apps.name: Digital Hunger
apps.short_description: A true-crime investigation inside a killer's 1999 desktop. Dig through his files, crack his secrets, and answer a call that rings on your real phone. English subtitles, Hebrew voice. 3 endings.

apps.name: Dough it Yourself
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bakery where every ingredient comes from your own farm. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into flour, butter and jam. Bake fresh bread, serve hungry customers, get to know the regulars, and grow your bakery one step at a time.

apps.name: DreaMon World
apps.short_description: DreaMon World is a modern virtual pet, RPG, adventure. Enter a realm filled with mysterious creatures called DreaMon. Nurture, train, and evolve your very own DreaMon friend, all while embarking on a journey to find your way home!

apps.name: Drowned Lake
apps.short_description: When Bento, an amateur documentarian vanishes, three strangers are drawn to the Drowned Lake to find him. As the lake’s dark past comes to light, so do the secrets buried deep within them. Explore, survive, and investigate the dark waters in this fishing survival horror game.

apps.name: Dummy House
apps.short_description: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

apps.name: Dungeon Crossing
apps.short_description: A top-down puzzle game blending dungeon exploration with minesweeper deduction, featuring randomly generated dungeons, ever-rising danger, and five upgradeable skills. Read the number clues, mark the hazards, collect the key, and clear all 30 floors.

apps.name: Dungeon Misfits
apps.short_description: A co-op roguelike for the brave, the reckless and the questionably qualified. Team up with up to 8 players, choose from 15 classes, and dive into endless dungeons where every drop rolls differently and every death is final.

apps.name: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga
apps.short_description: Unite a shattered Han China in 190, 194, 200 or 208 AD. Govern cities, raise spearmen, swordsmen, archers, cavalry and catapults, court allies and betray them. Every officer has a face, a history and a grudge. Turn-based grand strategy with tactical hex battles. Single player, no microtransactions.

apps.name: Endless Monday: In Progress
apps.short_description: "Endless Monday: In Progress" - New job, new Penny. Our favorite former corporate grunt is back, and working hard to live the dream! But as she struggles to keep the dream alive, she'll need all the help she can get, from friends, angry ex-coworkers, the past, and beyond.

apps.name: ESCAPE: Orphanage
apps.short_description: A psychological thriller set in Scarlet Orphanage, where every choice shapes the fate of the residents. Nothing is as it seems. Are you facing ghosts… or something far worse?

apps.name: FayFeather
apps.short_description: A story-driven puzzle journey through real bird photography. Join Xiaohong to free birds trapped in photographs, discover five puzzle styles, and meet the wild birds of China. Earn feathers to unlock and save your favorite original photos.
publishers: Wuhu Plumbeous Water Redstart Technology Co., Ltd.

apps.name: Fear Night Tales - Camp Story
apps.short_description: The third game in the Fear Night Tales series takes you to a mysterious camp. Tell the story, live the nightmare. Explore, talk, and choose in a first-person cinematic horror experience.

apps.name: Fieldworks
apps.short_description:
Start with a hoe and four tiles of dirt. End with an agricultural empire.
Farm, breed, and chain 179 recipes across four tiers — with no rot, no
bankruptcy, and nothing that can ever die. Quality only goes up. The only
enemy is your own floor plan.

apps.name: Fishbrary
apps.short_description: Keep a mysterious fishing library on your desktop. Open six books to discover real fish, oddly adorable mutants, and prehistoric creatures. Display your catches in an aquarium, enjoy Idle or timed Focus Mode, and uncover an investigator's notes as your collection grows.

apps.name: Fishish
apps.short_description: Following his father’s death, Ansel continues his quiet life in an old house beside a pond. Feed the fish, sort through what remains, and endure seven days of subtle disturbances as the familiar becomes increasingly difficult to explain.

apps.name: FLEETING ESCAPE
apps.short_description: FLEETING ESCAPE is a wave-based survival horror game where every choice could be your last. You must escape to a different island at the end of each wave to survive. Each island has monsters, items, and loot to be discovered.

apps.name: Flipside 86
apps.short_description: A coin-flicking roguelike in a neon 1986 casino. Slingshot coins into the bowl, bounce them into a JACKPOT CHAIN, stack CHIPS × MULT, then spend the winnings at Lucky's bar. 100 tables, 10 venues, one House to break. Then let it ride.

apps.name: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
apps.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

apps.name: ForgeCraft
apps.short_description: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

apps.name: Forsakia
apps.short_description: You're a bounty hunter working off a depot's job board: fly into zones held by armed contractors, slip past or break their patrols, loot what you can carry, and hold an extraction zone until the helicopter takes you home.

apps.name: Fur Fun 2
apps.short_description: Destroy the internet and the social networks infected with every kind of unbearable character. Mai (the cat) has come to shut down every last server and return the web to its golden age of cute kittens and fun for everyone.

apps.name: Fusebreak
apps.short_description: Dig. Blast. Stay quiet. Fusebreak is a top-down action-puzzle game where every wall is a potential shortcut, every explosion draws attention, and one wrong move can bury you. Outsmart the guards, navigate deadly hazards, and find your way through a prison built to keep people in.

apps.name: GANA FORCE
apps.short_description: Gana Force is a Horizontal shooter where you'll unleash powerful firepower, skillfully dodge bullets, and utilize the terrain to maneuver and defeat enemies. Game environments include alien cell levels, scorching sun, space battleships, and more. Powerful bosses and bullet hell challenges await you!

apps.name: Garage Sale Simulator
apps.short_description: Start your very own Garage Sale, solo or with a friend! Set your prices, haggle with neighbors, explore nearby yard sales, and decorate and upgrade your Garage Sale to your heart's content!

apps.name: Genetic Survivors
apps.short_description: Breed your strongest survivors and bend the rules of genetics to create the ultimate fighting bloodline. Discover powerful mutation combos, build synergistic teams, and evolve toward the genetic apex in this roguelite autobattler.

apps.name: Genomino
apps.short_description: Build DNA-treatment machines, route nucleotides, and cure increasingly complex patients. Choose your Doctor, upgrade the Genominator, and uncover a biotech conspiracy that could determine humanity's next evolution.

apps.name: Glacier Fishing
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based fishing game. You and your friends get four days on a glacier island to sell enough fish to keep the job. The penguins are not on your side.

apps.name: Gravity Trials
apps.short_description: Manipulate gravity, move objects, and solve handcrafted physics puzzles in a mysterious sci-fi facility. Discover new mechanics, explore strange environments, uncover secrets, and rethink space, direction, and movement.

apps.name: Grid Gear TD
apps.short_description: Why settle for a tower that only does one job? Slow the front line with Cryo Round, yank the pack into a black hole with Gravity Well, and fry the pileup with Chain Arc. All on one tower—as long as you can fit them onto the grid.

apps.name: Hazard Warning
apps.short_description: Hazard Warning is a multiplayer game where every tool can turn the arena into a trap. Dig holes, create slippery floors, power dangerous devices, and dodge all the traps you've left behind.

apps.name: Head Case
apps.short_description: Run a failing pawn shop during the night shift. Scrub grime off junk, punch out the dents, and sell it to the internet people. Listen to the voice inside your head and run them hands against whoever needs it. Tackle the struggles of loneliness and no confidence.

apps.name: Hell March
apps.short_description: A first-person voxel war shooter where you are just one soldier in an endless march. Fight on foot beside your army, man tank cannons and machine guns, and survive drone swarms, paratroopers and war bosses to reach extraction alive — solo or in co-op.

apps.name: Hell Of Steel
apps.short_description: Hell of Steel is a top-down roguelike shooter set in an AI apocalypse. You'll shoot your way through randomly generated levels full of robots, blowing things up and overpowering yourself with sci-fi gadgets, in humanity's final mission to take back Earth!

apps.name: HELL-A
apps.short_description: An online co-op horror action game. Enter the bureaucratic Hell and prove your worth through the Seven Deadly Sins. Master physics, combine magic, and face the trials together or turn on your friends. Maybe they hold you back?

apps.name: Hello! Dango! Desktop!
apps.short_description: "Hello! Dango! Desktop!" is an idle virtual pet game. Let your pet perch on screen edges or windows, or hang from your cursor and sway as you work or study. Care for it or simply enjoy its company to earn rewards and buy over 100 decorations for its room.

apps.name: Help me Cleaner Sama!  I Got Isekai’d to Clean Monster Girl Basements
apps.short_description: A poor street cleaner, exhausted from overtime, is sucked into a portal and finds himself before a self-centered goddess, who entrusts him with a task as absurd as it is inevitable: to clean out the cellars of the Monster Girls who inhabit that world.

apps.name: Hentai Senpai: Jester's Wild
apps.short_description: Step into the chaotic circus of sexy harlequin jesters! Solve multiple puzzle modes to unlock their most depraved, exhibitionist backstage performances. With explicit music, co-op, full gallery, and detailed character profiles, these mischievous girls are ready to put on a show!

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Papa Katsu APP - Healed With Her Boobs
apps.short_description: "Let me take all of today's pain... and make it melt away." Before you know it, two very different women take you by the hand, leading you through a night where your stress is drained out of you—completely.

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Tanned Childhood Hidden Tits
apps.short_description:
The tomboy who used to climb trees and chase me through the fields.
She still had the short black hair and sun-kissed skin I remembered.
But the body under that tank top… 
had grown into something she could no longer hide.

apps.name: Heresy Of The Flesh
apps.short_description: Command a forbidden sanctuary in the bowels of a dying gothic starship. Seduce, collect and breed over 150 souls, tear open relic packs, send your squad deck by deck against flesh-cults and machine saints, and unlock over 2,000 animated scenes. The flesh is the last sacrament.

apps.name: Hobby Hollow
apps.short_description: An artsy indie all about fun, low-stakes leisure activites, discovering new art and music from indie creators, and even sharing your own art and music with other players!

apps.name: I Am A Wizard
apps.short_description: Wait, I’m a wizard? It might be the coolest thing ever! An 18+ gay fantasy visual novel and dating sim. Discover magical powers, romance multiple male characters, and unlock animated adult scenes. Master Defense, Magic, and Slave powers as you shape your new life.

apps.name: I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing
apps.short_description: Every hero summoned to this world got an amazing skill. You got [Idle]: you only get stronger while doing absolutely nothing. Your party fights the Demon Lord's armies. You nap under a tree and collect all the EXP. An idle comedy that plays better when you're not playing it.

apps.name: Idol On Duty
apps.short_description: A Beat-Em-Up starring a J-Pop-inspired magical girl Aiko who bashes corporate demons over the head while swapping between a Pop mode and a Metal mode.

apps.name: Incremon Story
apps.short_description: A monster-battling incremental with a story and lots of humor. Hatch your monster, watch it evolve, catch new creatures and take on bosses that don't play fair. Saving the world is the easy part. Getting your mom to stop calling is another story.

apps.name: inFADErs
apps.short_description: inFADErs is a barbershop simulator where every hair on your customer's head is real. Thousands of strands grow, fall, flop when wet and stand up when dry, and every one of them is judged when the cut is done.

apps.name: Inner City Heat
apps.short_description: Steal the ride. Lose the heat. Explore a stylized coastal city in this open-world action game. Take to the streets on foot or behind the wheel, customize your ride, and outrun a pursuit that escalates from local cops to the Army.

apps.name: Into the Dust
apps.short_description: Top-down tactical co-op extraction shooter. Up to four players scavenge, fight, and rebuild in the harsh, post-apocalyptic wastelands of Dust Bowl America.

apps.name: Iron Dice
apps.short_description: Outthink rivals, not tooltips. Lead one of 30+ kingdoms in a medieval grand strategy game where every system shows its work. Build traceable economies, weigh the odds before committing your armies to battle, and carry a complete campaign to victory.

apps.name: Journeyman
apps.short_description: Journeyman is a 1-10 player co-op ARPG/CRPG hybrid featuring Souls-inspired combat, deep character customization, classes, talent trees, and endless procedural dungeon content. Descend as far as your gear and grit will take you, or perfect your build in online PvP.

apps.name: JUST CLIMB, AI!
apps.short_description: You don't climb. The AI does. Tell a small, slightly overconfident robot "go to that red container" by typing it, saying it into the mic, or dropping a pin on the spot. Then just watch. ...And watch it misjudge the jump and fall a few hundred metres.

apps.name: Kalit
apps.short_description: A unique survival adventure, animated in a 1930s rubber hose style! Fight to survive: capture creatures, farm, mine, and craft everything you need: from gear and vehicles to your base. Explore strange lands and an underwater world of shipwrecks, dangers, and hidden wonders.

apps.name: KaroKowe Jam
apps.short_description: Pick a song, mute your instrument's stem, and play along with the rest of the band. Slow it down, loop the hard parts and record your take. Coming soon.

apps.name: Keepsake County
apps.short_description: Burglarize hideous farmhouses in the middle of nowhere and get outta dodge. You have moments before the cops arrive to rob a procedurally-generated house that you've never seen before. If you're caught, residents will call the police  even sooner... or take the law into their own hands.

apps.name: Keycap Story: Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: The cat knocked the keyboards off the desk and the keys are everywhere! Play as a tiny desk toy: run, jump and climb across cozy rooms and snap every keycap back into its slot before the owner returns. Play solo, team up in online co-op for up to 4 players, or race head to head.

apps.name: Kill the AI
apps.short_description: An action roguelike set in a dystopian future where the tech titans who built the AI are sent to kill it. Gun down swarms of glitching machines, level up, hack terminals, build your loadout and transform your weapon mid-run. No permanent upgrades: every win is pure skill.

apps.name: Knights & Squires
apps.short_description: A tactical siege board game of chained jumps and castle assaults. Command ten pawns and four knights, wipe out your rival or storm both castle gates. Play the AI, pass-and-play with friends, or go online, including 4-player team battles.

apps.name: Lagrange Front
apps.short_description: Lagrange Front is a team-based sci-fi FPS. Fight on foot, in zero gravity and in vehicles for a moving hill, haul a payload into the enemy flagship, or storm a ground map with tanks and walkers. Up to 48 players per match, with AI bots filling empty slots.

apps.name: Last Card
apps.short_description: A card roguelike played across the table from a masked dealer. Chain cards by color, number or symbol to stack chips and multipliers and beat the night's target. Miss it and a candle goes out. When the last one goes out, the house wins.

apps.name: Last Crew Out
apps.short_description: A 2D action roguelite for 1-4 players. Explore dangerous facilities, fight enemies and dodge deadly traps. Choose your role, rescue fallen teammates with shared epipens and pick your own upgrades. Get the whole crew out before the reactor goes critical.

apps.name: Last Latch
apps.short_description: The lock is right in front of you. The clue might be too. Pick up objects, turn them over for a closer look, and test your hunch on the mechanism. Solve 40 first-person escape rooms, from a basement to the bridge of a spaceship.

apps.name: Legends Of Glory
apps.short_description: Enter the arena as a gladiator and fight other players in real time. Choose your fighter, equip weapons and armor, then strike and survive. Train your gladiator, buy stronger gear, and climb the ranks. Every bout is live combat against other players.

apps.name: Lights Out Pact
apps.short_description: Lights Out Pact is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game. Everyone hides a random item in a freshly generated room, then searches for others'. You can't take your own. Miss an item and lose a body part. Last one standing wins. Modes: find everything, hunt your target, or last one to find loses.

apps.name: Liquid Swarm
apps.short_description:
Swallow swarms of monsters, earn XP, improve your stats, repeat.

Minimalist active incremental roguelite with rewarding and satisfying gameplay.

Reincarnate to get permanent XP bonuses and to unlock perks and Epic Bosses.

Play alone or with friends.

apps.name: Little Army Manager
apps.short_description: Please don't add this to your wishlist! I don't want to see any wishlists here. Thank you!

apps.name: Little Hamster: Find and Organize
apps.short_description: After a long journey, a little hamster returns home to his familiar daily routine. Yet even everyday tasks are full of adventure. Join him as you search for lost items, clean up, and organize the space in a new journey taking you from a forest little house to a lively town.

apps.name: Loot The World: Three Kings
apps.short_description: An infinite procedural RPG. Explore a dangerous world, roll the dice in combat, loot everything, and hunt down the Three Kings.

apps.name: Lucky Luke: The Lonesome Cowboy Collection
apps.short_description: Step into the cowboy boots of Lucky Luke: “the man who shoots faster than his own shadow.” Inspired by the satirical comics, this 2D platformer collection features six retro Lucky Luke titles with colorful pixel graphics and cartoony Western charm. Saddle up for side scroller action on the frontier.

apps.name: Lust Island Village : Horny Waifus
apps.short_description: Left alone in an island village, run a small diner and cook the fish you catch. Regulars by day, secret lovers by night. Grow close to 12 married women through cooking, fishing and secret messages, and at the end of each story, enjoy a passionate love meant for just the two of you.

apps.name: MAEVOR
apps.short_description: MAEVOR is a 1-4 player co-op horror game set in a cursed forest where every sound can get you killed. Recover three ancient artifacts, break the Harpy Vampire Demon's curse, and survive against creatures that hunt by sound while fear distorts your senses.

apps.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
apps.short_description: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

apps.name: Maybe It Meant Something
apps.short_description: Platform as a clumsy cat through several atmospheric environments in a potentially pointless effort to find the story.

apps.name: Mechannihilation
apps.short_description: Pilot a mech through escalating swarms in Survivors, lead an army to capture relays and break the enemy HQ shield in Commanders, or roam the Open World to raid outposts and hunt biome bosses. Pair maxed weapons to unleash EX attacks.

apps.name: Mergeopolis
apps.short_description: Merge matching buildings to grow a tiny island into a thriving city. Plan residential, commercial, industrial, and civic districts, reinvest their income, unlock more land, and build at your own pace in this relaxing incremental city builder.

apps.name: Midgard Arena
apps.short_description: Lead a party of four anime heroes across a shared 3D world. Hunt in real time on the same maps as other players, take down world bosses together, trade at the player market and test your build in 5v5 Arena and Battle Royale.

apps.name: Minesweeper Collection
apps.short_description:
A collection of Minesweeper modes: Classic 2D, Hex, Triangles, Surface, and the hardest 3D mode, where each cell has up to 26 neighbours.
No-guess boards, 3BV/s and efficiency on every game, full replay analysis, plus daily challenges and Steam leaderboards in every mode.

apps.name: Misnomers by Nick Oueijan
apps.short_description: A preposterous word game where you create a recursive language, one word at a time! Laugh (or cry) as you define each word from other words and your decisions snowball beyond expectations. Decipher definitions, discover drawings, then use your save file to translate the internet!

apps.name: Monster Mine IDLE
apps.short_description: A free-to-play idle mining game: build a crew of cute miners, explore six biomes, open chests and eggs, and forge gear. Collapse the game into a compact bar and let the mine keep working while you use your computer.

apps.name: Motion de censure
apps.short_description: Step into the French National Assembly and lead your campaign in this strategic card game. Unlock new political parties, expand their decks, then challenge the AI or another candidate online in tactical debates where every card can overturn the majority.

apps.name: Moto Courier Simulator
apps.short_description: Ride 12 real-sounding bikes through San Verano and the wider Calvera County. Take the order, pack it right and ring the bell before time runs out – then wrench in your own garage, run a store, live a crime story and ride with up to 4 friends in co-op.

apps.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
apps.short_description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

apps.name: Mr. Pig's Platforming Diet
apps.short_description: A casual, hand-drawn, procedurally-generated platformer about a Pig forced into his nightmare... physical exercise! Jump around, dodge traps, and manage the un-athletic Mr. Pig's limited endurance through 30 level runs, or within the Endless mode.

apps.name: My Days with a Clueless Demon Lord
apps.short_description: Step into an unpredictable adventure with the mischievous Demon Lord, Manamia! Explore a relationship offering a mix of humor and intimacy as you navigate her playful quirks and the challenges of living together. Will you guide her gently or embrace her wild side?

apps.name: Mythia Wild Bonds
apps.short_description: You are the monster. Pick a creature, survive massive hordes, and bond with the ones you defeat to unlock them for good. A pixel-art survivors-like where every run grows your collection and every creature can evolve into a stronger form.

apps.name: Nekopara Sekai Connect
apps.short_description:
A heartwarming Neko comedy that connects these felines from all across the globe!
With over 7 million copies sold worldwide, the latest entry
in the popular adventure game series NEKOPARA is here!

apps.name: Nijoaju
apps.short_description: Two characters. One goal. Think as one. In Nijoaju, control a powerful stone creature and an agile water creature, combining their unique abilities to solve challenging puzzles, overcome obstacles, and prove that only by working together can you move forward.

apps.name: No Wings Required
apps.short_description: A pocket-sized adventure about a flightless duck and his trusty balloon. Explore the Featherfall Islands, take on wildly chaotic tasks, and prove that “winging it” might actually be a valid career strategy.

apps.name: Off the Eaten Path
apps.short_description: Off the Eaten Path is a quiet narrative idle-cooking game: gather ingredients, unlock recipes, fill orders, and keep a handwritten catalogue of everything you taste. The kitchen keeps cooking while you are away.

apps.name: One Matter, One Hexagram
apps.short_description: A little ink-turtle lives on your desktop. Ask one question, tap the coin jar, and watch it cast six throws. A woodblock-printed leaf slides in - tear it off, keep it, or export it. Fully offline.

apps.name: One More Asteroid
apps.short_description: Drill voxel asteroids apart in an incremental mining game. Grow from one drill to a swarm of drones that mine where you aim. Unlock powerful tools, crack the core and watch the asteroid collapse. Then take on the next, stranger rock.

apps.name: Onward! Autobattles
apps.short_description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onward! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

apps.name: Open Skies
apps.short_description: The deep Aerobiz successor. Build a turn-based airline empire across 175 real cities, painted like the 90s Koei classics: court sixty patrons, hire executives, make the Herald's front page, and outplay rivals that follow your rules and play to win.

apps.name: OVERPULSE
apps.short_description: OVERPULSE is a fast-paced neon roguelite shooter built around intense 20-minute runs. Choose a weapon, stack upgrades, unlock its Overpulse, and survive escalating swarms, minibosses, and a final boss as your build grows from simple to screen-filling chaos.

apps.name: OVERSPRAY
apps.short_description: OVERSPRAY is a free-to-play tactical 4v4 paintball shooter. Buy your gear every round, fight over a single flag in the middle of the map and read the fresh paint to track your enemies. Nobody dies — everybody gets soaked.

apps.name: Pawprint Trails
apps.short_description: Solve cozy animal logic puzzles and help little friendships bloom. Find every friend's place across 128 puzzles, create ten shared sanctuary projects, and collect memories of picnics, stargazing, baking, and more.

apps.name: Pet that Dog
apps.short_description: Pet and collect 50+ breeds of dogs in our doggy dress up desktop companion! Every tap or click is a pet for your pup! If you pet your dog enough, they might dig up fun accessories you can use to dress them up!

apps.name: Petsino
apps.short_description: Petsino - your desktop companion and a place for shared minigames. Make the wait for your match more enjoyable: play solo or get your friends involved - in the break between one game and the next. Collect pets, earn accessories, and dress up your pet as you like. Your desktop, your squad, your fun.

apps.name: Phatfranks & Stangmars: Crazy Adventure in Germany
apps.short_description: The party is over. The zombies aren't. A story-driven first-person shooter through a Germany gone wrong: play solo with AI or in two-player online co-op, with bloody fights, eerie atmosphere and outrageous dark humour.

apps.name: Pickle & Biscuit
apps.short_description: A high fantasy action RPG at the end of the world. Outrun an evil Fog that takes anyone too slow, with a fire-mad young mage and her sharp-tongued healer brother. Outthink the Taken and bandits that each fight their own way, and laugh through thousands of voiced lines.

apps.name: Piece of Cake: Cozy Bakery
apps.short_description: Restore a cozy café in this relaxing merge puzzle game. Combine pastries, tools, and decorations, complete customer orders, unlock new story moments, and bring every corner of your dream café back to life.

apps.name: Pin City
apps.short_description: Pin City is a VR bowling game with the spirit of mini-golf! Silly yet challenging, strive for a perfect game and explore the bowling alley!

apps.name: Pinball Boss Quest
apps.short_description: Pinball meets block breaker in a pixel-art fantasy quest. Bat the ball through minion waves, smash breakables and topple ten legendary bosses as a Sword, Bow, Javelin, Mage or Summoner, solo or in local co-op where you team up on the boss but compete for the top score.

apps.name: PinDOS
apps.short_description: Play your own copies of Epic Pinball, Silver Ball, Silver Ball 2 Plus and Extreme Pinball in a new front end: the whole table on one tall screen with no scrolling, 2-4 players online or on your home network, and a full virtual pinball cabinet mode. The games are not included.

apps.name: Pixel Farm
apps.short_description: A cozy farming game to enjoy at your own pace. Plant and sell crops, expand your farm, and let a little automation help along the way.

apps.name: Pixel Platoons
apps.short_description: Lead your squad through explosive pixel-art missions across desert, tundra and jungle battlefields. Recruit, train and promote soldiers, compete for medals and global records, and live with every loss. Every soldier matters. Every death is permanent.

apps.name: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
apps.short_description: Create the ultimate Pocket Racer hobby shop. Stock the shelves, open car packs, build miniature race cars and expand your store over time. Design custom tracks and invite your friends over to help run the shop or to throw down on the latest track setup.

apps.name: Poking Nun
apps.short_description: An adult NTR visual novel set in a fantasy medieval world. Watch helplessly as you lose your pure, devoted nun wife to corruption and lust.

apps.name: polymorphite
apps.short_description: Rhythm-dodging adventure game about a mysterious set of murders. Come then; decide the past, so that we may glimpse at a better future.

apps.name: Popo and the Moonlit Shop
apps.short_description: A magical shop simulator where you gather materials with your Popos, craft goods, and keep display stands full while fulfilling your customers' requests. Customise the shop to fit your aesthetic, and travel between worlds to open new branches of your Moonlit Shop!

apps.name: Project Berserk
apps.short_description: The fight for the future starts now. Fight with or against your friends with crazy sci-fi tech, innovative mechanics, and a classic yet colorful retro feel!

apps.name: PurpleStar
apps.short_description: A dead island. A town crawling with the Mindless. Something in the woods that only moves when you look away, and smiles before it kills. Scavenge, forge your weapons, hold your base against raiders and survive the night, alone or with up to 7 friends.

apps.name: Purrfect Circuit
apps.short_description: Coach a cast of racers through training days, personal stories, and spirited competition. Find your favorite, help her shine, and cheer her down the home stretch. You can also challenge your friends in online races for up to six players!

apps.name: Quiet Hours
apps.short_description: It's 2AM, the truck is loud, your friends are louder, and everybody on this street is a light sleeper. Quiet Hours is online co-op for 1–4 players on a night garbage route, where your real voice is noise the street can hear. Microphone strongly recommended.#

apps.name: Quitter's Quest
apps.short_description: Quit your job in Quitters Quest! Escape your soul-crushing office job by solving puzzles, outsmarting annoying coworkers, and talking to everything in this classic-style point and click adventure. Take what's left of your dignity and get the hell out.

apps.name: QUTAS67 - Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
apps.short_description: QUTAS 67 is a clicker game set in the year 2067, where players build a criminal empire by clicking and hiring managers to rob increasingly larger buildings with the ultimate goal of finally "releasing" the iconic, endlessly delayed game. 6️⃣7️⃣

apps.name: Rabid
apps.short_description: RABID is a dark fantasy tactical RPG where blackjack fuels every battle. Lead a team of mutated animals, customize your decks, collect powerful loot, and master turn-based combat as you uncover the dark secrets of a mysterious laboratory.

apps.name: Ratscension
apps.short_description: A top-down roguelite action dungeon crawler. Ascend the tower and fight the evil rat wizard. Avoid dangerous enemies. Find valuable loot. Build your character and explore the tower. Play solo or online co-op with friends!

apps.name: RC Glider Sim
apps.short_description: Fly radio-controlled gliders on the slopes of Castle Hill in West Yorkshire. Launch by hand, ride the ridge lift, adjust the wind and time of day, and practise slope soaring alone or with friends through Steam multiplayer.

apps.name: Reign of Slime
apps.short_description: An action roguelike: a slime fights, dies and comes back stronger, climbing toward the throne of the slime king. Shift elements, exploit their reactions, stack abilities and power-ups into your build. Hmm. Interesting, you're still reading. Anyways, I knew you would.

apps.name: REISIR0b: PIZZA RUN
apps.short_description: 🍕A fast-paced 2D Metroidvania about an elite combat android mercenary who shoots, tears across land, space, and water, opens boxes with random upgrades, and takes on the craziest job in the galaxy — ALL FOR PIZZA.

apps.name: Resequence: The Orchard
apps.short_description: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.

apps.name: Rhythm Nexus
apps.short_description: Drive to the beat down a road that is forgetting itself. Switch lanes, jump and rescue lost souls while a voice on the radio guides you — and the Collector closes in behind. A rhythm action road trip about memory, music and finding the way home.

apps.name: RIO - Raised In Oblivion
apps.short_description: There was an infection in a large part of Rio De Janeiro and, in order not to spread, the government built retaining walls, whoever is inside will not be able to leave and will have to survive until the cure is discovered.

apps.name: Risky Renovations
apps.short_description: Every property has a story, and some are far from pretty. Clean up the mess, make the repairs, renovate each room, and turn those properties into profit.

apps.name: Road To Zero
apps.short_description: Embark on a long journey through a war-torn world. Discover abandoned vehicles, swap engines, repair and restore cars, and explore forgotten places. Hit the road with friends, build your perfect ride, and make your way toward the mysterious Site Zero.

apps.name: Rogue Maze
apps.short_description: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

apps.name: ROZE: The Revenant of Zero Entropy
apps.short_description: Embark on a dark fantasy journey as Rozelia in this action sandbox dungeon-crawler. Navigate board-game style maps, master side scrolling action combat, and turn the tide against demonic grabs using Bloodserker counters. Don't let your Corruption gauge max out!

apps.name: Rugby Deck
apps.short_description: Rugby, played with cards. Take a village club from the cow field to the World Cup, one cup at a time. Read what the other team is about to do, play your hand, win the scrum, keep the referee sweet. Between matches, fill your playbook, fight for the table and grow your club.

apps.name: RUN OR RUIN
apps.short_description: Steal vehicles, take on jobs and escape an escalating police pursuit. RUN OR RUIN mixes shootouts, car chases and explosive chain reactions in an open city, solo or with friends over LAN. Includes Classic and Tactical, with team matches up to 5v5. Bad plans. Worse escapes.

apps.name: Runecast
apps.short_description: A pixel-art autobattler: cast runes, set your company across three lanes and watch your strategy decide the fight. Merge heroes, pick promotions, gear up your troop and march through four acts, from the Palisade to the Basalt Hall, against bosses that demand preparation.

apps.name: Saga Star
apps.short_description: Stop an all-out war in this PS2-inspired action platformer as you explore over 16 environments under attack. Shoot enemies, smash loads of breakables for money, upgrade your weapons and armor, discover hidden items, and become a true Warrior of the prestigious Saga Star.

apps.name: Salvage Heart
apps.short_description: Forty-one years ago, the lower town of Merrowby slid into a trench in a single night. You're the last pilot of VertWil Salvage. Dive its wreck layer by layer in a small yellow sub: cut through the silt, bring up what's buried, surface before your air runs out, and find what waits at the bottom.

apps.name: Save the President
apps.short_description: 🏛️A political strategy game about the dirty side of power. Blackmail letters, secret deals and rival ministers land on your desk every day. Build your region, run your team and survive the election. Every choice has a price, and someone always finds out.

apps.name: Scramble Heart City
apps.short_description: Scramble Heart City is a 3v3 tag-team fighter that's easy to pick up and play. It's time to beat up your friends and find new ones! Battle anywhere with local and online multiplayer and browser cross-play.

apps.name: Scrapstorm
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player bullet-heaven roguelite where the whole city is hunting you. Draft cards every level until one pistol turns into a screen-clearing mess, and watch out for the traffic, the third rail and whatever is running each district.

apps.name: Sea Adventure
apps.short_description: You scrape barnacles in Miami. Then your uncle vanishes at sea and leaves you a superyacht, a loan due in thirty days, and a crew of gorgeous women who don't think you deserve her. Earn the ship. Earn the crew.

apps.name: Seabun
apps.short_description: Seabun is an incremental 2D survivor-like with creature collection elements, where you play a scientist bunny diving deeper and deeper to find the source of the sea's corruption. Haul your loot home between dives, grow your lab, and raise the fish you rescue into rideable mounts.

apps.name: Sharktooth Bay
apps.short_description: Dig for shark teeth, sift through the sand, and stock a seaside fossil shop with what you find. Set your prices, arrange your displays, and sell to visiting beachgoers. Keep your favorite finds for your own collection.

apps.name: Sidebound
apps.short_description: A transparent 3D idle RPG that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Your heroes fight and grow while you work, browse, or watch. Collect powerful loot, build your own party for dragon raids, and turn a humble forge into an empire.

apps.name: SiegeLine
apps.short_description: SiegeLine is a four-way fantasy strategy battle. Your barracks send waves at your neighbors on their own. You decide where the gold goes: income, upgrades, heroes and base spells. No unit control: every choice is about timing. Inspired by the classic Survival Chaos custom map.

apps.name: Silklings: A Desktop Pet
apps.short_description: A cozy desktop pet about a pixel spider who lives on your screen. Create your own Silkling, then watch them spin a web in the corner, hunt the bugs that wander by and bring you each catch wrapped like a present. Unwrap them, collect many kinds of bug and record every find in your Book.

apps.name: Six Coins
apps.short_description: Six Coins is a single-player, turn-based card game where coins are both your life and your currency. Draw to improve your hand, stand to save your coins, and equip trinkets for an edge at the table. Chase a matching pair, weigh each risk, and make your six coins count.

apps.name: Sleeping Oli
apps.short_description: Alone, you are nothing. She is your shield, your sword. Apart, you are nothing but prey. In this psychological horror action-adventure, survival depends entirely on your bond. No one will take her away from you. No one.

apps.name: Slipline
apps.short_description: Surf angled ramps and bunny hop across floating low-poly sky islands. CS-inspired surf and bhop movement, 30 hand-built maps, online servers with leaderboards, and a co-op map builder. Early Access. Keyboard and mouse.

apps.name: Space Miner: Orbital Claim
apps.short_description: Pilot a battered mining ship through Earth’s asteroid ring in this voxel space sim. Cut ore from drifting rocks, sell your haul, and upgrade your ship. Claim new sectors and set up mining rigs and hauler drones to keep the ore moving while you explore.

apps.name: Space Wrecker: Turn and Burn
apps.short_description: Haul the scrap home and sell it before your fuel, runs out. Avoid asteroids, turn and burn, a top-down space salvage arcade game where every burn, and every bullet, and every second costs you. Time is money and so is Fuel, and Ammo.

apps.name: SPEARPOINT - Delta Unit 7
apps.short_description:
SPEARPOINT - Delta Unit 7 is a no-frills FPS inspired by the early tactical shooters of the late 90's. 
Engage in long range battles across varied and expansive landscapes, complete objectives and exfil.

apps.name: Spirit Fox
apps.short_description: Spirit Fox is a short, atmospheric, third-person narrative adventure in which you step into the paws of a young fox who, following an unexpected tragedy, finds himself completely alone in an unfamiliar place. What lies in store in this place?

apps.name: Squabblin Goblins
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.

apps.name: Sr Fox
apps.short_description: The lighthouse has gone dark, and ships can no longer reach the island. Join Fox, its lighthouse keeper, in a mystery adventure: explore the island and find a way to repair the lighthouse without spare parts or outside help, before night falls.

apps.name: Star Archive: Tidying Up Is a Kind of Magic
apps.short_description: The library's a mess, and it won't let you leave. Sort and stack books at your own pace in this cozy first-person game. Cast spells to send books back to their shelves, open new wings, and carry permanent upgrades into the next time loop.

apps.name: Stellar Mage
apps.short_description: An action incremental game. Your mage fights endless waves of monsters on her own, and you decide how she gets stronger. Pick her spells, spend your gold on upgrades, and keep pushing further down the road.

apps.name: Stitchborn
apps.short_description: Stitchborn is a dark fantasy roguelite auto battler where you play the monster. Raid villages and farms, tear off body parts from your victims and stitch them onto yourself, brew potions in your master's tower and send minions to fight beside you, until the King's army comes for you.

apps.name: Suck It Dry! with Your Friends
apps.short_description: Your boss wants the ocean empty. You get a teaspoon. Scoop, schlep and sabotage your way through an impossible job with up to 16 friends – but one of you secretly works for NEPTUN Resorts and wants the sea to stay full.

apps.name: Sucronomicon
apps.short_description: An online co-op PC/VR horror game for up to 4 players. Team up in haunted kitchen arenas to craft enchanted confections and break the witch's curse while battling relentless baked beasts that storm the kitchen to stop you.

apps.name: Survivor Rat vs Zombies
apps.short_description: A zombie-survival game that lives on top of your desktop. By day a gas-masked rat scavenges, crafts and builds a tree house; by night it holds the ladder against the horde. The tiny island floats over your windows while you work — and never gets in the way.

apps.name: Taccy: TacFPS Aim Trainer
apps.short_description: Taccy is a lightweight tactical FPS aim trainer built around actual in-game scenarios. Train corner clears, holds, counter-strafing and aim duels, then replay every rep to see what caused each miss.

apps.name: Taubenchaos
apps.short_description: Be the pigeon the city deserves! Peck healthy grain, splat unsuspecting tourists, dodge the janitor and take on 32 wild bosses - alone, on one couch or online with a friend via Steam. 96 levels, Boss Rush, Endless mode and a music box with 101 tracks.

apps.name: The Cabbage Effect
apps.short_description: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter with brawl elements that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

apps.name: The Cauldron
apps.short_description: The Cauldron is a co-op alchemy game where one wrong ingredient can burn down the lab. With up to 4 friends, mix the elements to fill strange orders, raid portal worlds for exotic loot and survive whatever you just brought to life.

apps.name: The Dragon's Mint
apps.short_description: Meet Kebbo, a sleepy dragon and master coinmaker, running a tiny mint in the corner of your desktop. He strikes coins and earns marks while you get on with your day. Check in when you like to answer letters, travel the kingdoms and help him fill his book.

apps.name: The Endless Museum
apps.short_description: Wikipedia turned into a museum you can walk around, where every article is a room and every link is a doorway. You can wander wherever the links take you and read about each room as you go, race friends between articles, or look for the secret passages, puzzles and hidden rooms behind the bookcases.

apps.name: The Film Archive
apps.short_description: Restore order to a film archive in this cozy first-person sorting game. Inspect films, reunite numbered reels, and shelve 400 films across three floors. Unlock useful upgrades and turn towering piles of film cans into a satisfying, organized collection.

apps.name: The Fourth Sense Evolution: Stone Age
apps.short_description:
Top-Down, 2D, Evolution, Survival, and Cult-Themed Game 
Be a God, Evolve Your Followers, and Spread Your Faith in a Stone Age Sandbox Game

apps.name: The Gloaming Hand
apps.short_description: A free online card battler where the sky decides the fight. Plant units at Dawn, let them ripen through the Day, strike before Dusk and bluff through the Night. Five lanes, four phases, one sundial: every card is worth something different at every hour.

apps.name: The Idle Captain
apps.short_description: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.

apps.name: The Last Coin
apps.short_description: Bet your soul against other players in a casino you can't escape. Take turns dropping coins into a glass of whiskey about to overflow, keep your hand steady and cheat with items. Whoever overflows it loses their soul.

apps.name: The Ones Who Answered
apps.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

apps.name: The Patchwork Ship
apps.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder with a unique card-generating system for flexible strategic runs without micromanagement. Your brain controls a space probe fleeing a failed mining operation. Can you survive the hostile skies and escape a dying star?

apps.name: The Rift Between Us
apps.short_description: Jordan must traverse an apocalyptic world to find his love, Ember. Knowing not what fate has befallen her, Jordan will fight across any number of miles and confront any monstrosity the looming rift throws his way...

apps.name: The Rug Racket
apps.short_description: Inherit a rundown rug-cleaning shop and master a satisfying craft. Dust, wash, rinse and revive rugs one stain at a time. Build a reputation, keep the lights on, and squirm out from under the mob family that owns your debt. Every rug's a small win, and every tribute payment says you're not free yet.

apps.name: The Saga of Three Realms
apps.short_description: Every hunt could turn up rare treasure. Every road has its dangers, and any open patch of land could be your home. Saga is a classic sandbox MMORPG where you fight, craft, tame, trade and build your way to legend. The rest of the realm’s secrets, you’ll have to find.

apps.name: The Transfer
apps.short_description: A Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure. As a London Tube driver, your routine journey derails into something ancient, forgotten, and buried beneath the tracks. Explore hidden routes, follow the journey, and unravel the secrets that refuse to stay dormant.

apps.name: ThrillWorx
apps.short_description: Build a theme park, then grab a front-row seat. Design coaster tracks, choose from 100 attractions, and explore your midway on foot. When a ride goes down, climb into the WrenchWorx pickup, bring the parts, and get it running again

apps.name: Tidy Up Creator: Make And Play Tidy Up Games
apps.short_description: A hilarious cozy first-person tidying game for movie lovers! Hand crafted movie posters parodying real movies. Absolutely No Generative AI. Plus, a level editor to create your own packs and the same familiar game loop you’re familiar with in the genre.

apps.name: TION: Hero Awakening — Idle RPG
apps.short_description: Build your hero, collect gear, upgrade your stats and watch your character fight automatically. Push through harder enemies, bosses and new stages in this 2D incremental RPG.

apps.name: To Kill a God
apps.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

apps.name: Tomb Guard
apps.short_description: Tomb Guard is a real-time with pause tactics game. You control a band of skeletons as they defend their homeland from the invading Fiends. Focus is key, for facing overwhelming odds is certain. Pause, strategize, and attack to protect Tombstead and defeat The Order once and for all.

apps.name: Tower of Misfits
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op roguelite from one to 6 players. Pick one of twelve misfits, each with a weapon and an ultimate of their own, and climb a tower that never ends: a new world on every floor, bosses, perks, curses, and friends to fight over the chest with.

apps.name: Toyworks
apps.short_description: A cosy first-person incremental about building a toy workshop that works for you. Drop shapes into funnels, catch the coins, and automate toy production with belts, arms and assemblers. Fill orders, unlock new rooms, and discover where your toys go.

apps.name: Trading A Giantess
apps.short_description: A unique virtual trading simulator mixed with mature giantess interactions. Master the virtual forex market, trade virtual UGTS stocks, and unlock high-quality FMV fetish mini-games. No real money involved. (18+ Adult Content)

apps.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
apps.short_description: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

apps.name: Trust Me, It's a Shortcut
apps.short_description: Buy a wreck in the Maun bazaar and drive it round the Kalahari for ten days with up to three friends. No GPS, a blank paper map, a budget that buys nothing good, and a friendly local who keeps saying: trust me, it's a shortcut.

apps.name: Turbo Caster
apps.short_description: Turbo Caster is a survivors-like game with a circuit-style spell building system and roguelite elements. Play as a powerful wizard who uses magical runes to craft spells, discover chaotic synergies, and survive relentless waves of enemies while shaping your own arcane playstyle.

apps.name: Underking
apps.short_description: A first-person mining incremental game. Enter the cave to mine and extract valuable ores. Convert ores into coins and spend them on upgrades to extend your runs to reach deeper into the mountain.

apps.name: UnepicTale
apps.short_description: The dragon stole the princess, and now your path leads through dark forests and eerie swamps, teeming with fairy-tale creatures. Flip the card and prove you can handle the choice in the card game UnepicTale!

apps.name: Unpackmania
apps.short_description: Unpackmania is an incremental card collecting game where every pack you open has the potential to make you more powerful than the last. Fight off enemies, create combos, level up, and watch your power spiral out of control.

apps.name: Up the Creek!
apps.short_description: An online co-op physics comedy for 1–4 friends. Fish through the ice by hand, keep a melting floe level, drag frozen friends out of the water and drive the catch home in an old van. The Tsar-Pike is out there.

apps.name: VANADEN
apps.short_description: Vanaden is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed, fortress-like labyrinth. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and navigate shifting corridors where stealth and every decision determine your survival.

apps.name: Vanguard Armada
apps.short_description: Vanguard Armada is a turn-based starship fleet based tactics game. Build and customize a fleet of frigates, carriers, and battleships. Fight solo or co-op with up to three other players, earn persistent unlocks, and find allies in the multiplayer lobby.

apps.name: Village Invaders
apps.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite card battler where you raid villages. Deploy your army, cast wild spells and build the perfect deck to crush every kingdom in your path.

apps.name: Virtual Fighting Championship 2
apps.short_description:
Sequal to the OG VR title VFC, VFC2 is a VR fighting game where your body is the controller. Dive into intense PvE & PvP combat. Perform fighting moves and gestures to unleash shockwaves, fireballs and ultimates. Feel like you're inside Street Fighter™ or Dragon Ball™!
Discord at

apps.name: Visual Novel: 3:17 PM
apps.short_description: Eleven-year-old Asya arrives to visit her clockmaker grandfather in Chasovets, only to discover that time has frozen at 3:17. Alongside a talking cat and a boy collecting lost minutes in a jar, climb the old tower, solve the town's mystery, and give people back their tomorrow!

apps.name: Vita: Regenesis
apps.short_description: Ten thousand years after Atria stripped the world of the Vita and Maisha. She prepares to bring her children home. Follow Iino and his companions as they fight for survival and unravel the truth behind their connection to the world and master the elements in this classic JRPG that started it all.

apps.name: Voxel Surge
apps.short_description: Pilot a custom voxel mech down a 10,000 m shaft of floating islands, alien guardians and a Titan you can climb. Pick a class, build your loadout, bust through the floor, and drag up to three friends along in split-screen or online co-op.

apps.name: Wild Myth
apps.short_description: An online co-op adventure where you and your friends hunt for proof of the world’s most dangerous myths. All for the views. Go live. Capture the chaos. Run. Cut it into viral content. Stay live. Stay alive.

apps.name: Wildermeld
apps.short_description: Hunt four dragons in a side-scrolling dark fantasy RPG. Explore a world generated anew each game, build your hero, brave dangerous dungeons, craft equipment and survive hunger, fatigue and the wilds. Earn four kingdoms' trust, with optional permadeath.

apps.name: Windwhisper Saga
apps.short_description: Set out from Windbell as an adventurer in a pixel-art, side-scrolling action RPG. Explore dungeons, face bosses, and craft gear from the materials you bring home. Get to know the locals along the way, or take on a Demon Pact when you’re ready to risk more for better loot.

apps.name: Worlds of Colors
apps.short_description: Worlds of Colors takes place in a completely different universe from ours. Explore the different worlds, created by god-like beings known as the Overseers. You play as an inhabitant of these worlds called Nivu, guided by one of the Overseers trying to save the universe from collapsing.

apps.name: XBPlayer
apps.short_description: Stream games from your own Xbox console or from Xbox Cloud Gaming to your Steam Deck or Linux PC, at home or away. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. Pay once, no ads. Games and Game Pass are not included.

apps.name: Your Desktop Companion - Lumi
apps.short_description: Lumi is a local-first 3D AI companion that lives directly on your Windows desktop. Chat by text or voice, build a relationship over time, react to your music, and keep the core AI experience running locally on your PC.

apps.name: Zambala
apps.short_description:
Six warlords. One nation. No mercy.
A single player turn-based hex strategy game. Seize territory, buy loyalty, sabotage rivals, and outmanoeuvre five ruthless computer controlled factions in a brutal civil war. 

There can be no peace without war, no nation born without a scar.

apps.name: Zodiac: Story of the Guardian
apps.short_description: Explore a cavernous, retro pixel asteroid to save Earth from impending disaster!

apps.name: ハイシン | Haishin
apps.short_description:
One night, you casually start a livestream to show viewers around your room.
From that night on, your peaceful everyday life begins to fall apart...

apps.name: 万仙
apps.short_description: 开局即挂机，招募弟子、炼丹炼器、闯秘境占世界——一款桌面修仙放置网游。

apps.name: 不完美奇迹
apps.short_description: She has known you long, yet you meet her for the first time. A white‑haired girl smiles, confesses affection and calls you "Chen You" — yet you remember never meeting her. This meeting should’ve been the start of a romance visual novel. The sky grows restless; this world is far from "normal".

apps.name: 九号超市避难所
apps.short_description: "No. 9  Supermarket Shelter" is an apocalyptic zombie shooter where you can switch between top-down and third-person views: rogue-like missions,  base defense tower tasks, massive multiplayer PVP, complete freedom to customize your character and outfit. Play solo or team up online with friends.

apps.name: 九州之士
apps.short_description: 战国时代背景，剧情向 RPG 为主，融合大战略玩法。战国时代九州大地列国纷争，百姓流离，原本一介庶民的你，陷入了一场巨大的阴谋中，被亲情、友情与仇恨交织裹挟，踏上了拯救自己与万民苍生的旅途。

apps.name: 云星
apps.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

apps.name: 你的美腿
apps.short_description:
Pinch the stocking, pull, let go: it snaps back with a slap.
A game about legs and stockings and nothing else: touch them, tear them, get them wet.
Dozens of stockings and five pairs of shoes in the wardrobe, a water gun and a camera at hand. She gets shy, she says ouch, and slowly warms to you.

apps.name: 呱不要急
apps.short_description: Play solo against the computer in Hold Your Frogs! Dodge traffic as a frog or command the cars. Then try local two-player matches or Steam online 1v1 and 4v4. Swap sides at halftime and win with your skill build, timing and prediction.

apps.name: 夜班护士模拟器
apps.short_description: Survive 30 days in this psychological horror nursing sim. Balance routine medical tasks and time management while evading terrifying anomalies in the dark wards. Manage your dropping sanity, earn your paycheck, and escape before becoming the hospital's next permanent patient.

apps.name: 异世界厨房:女子高中生的美食餐厅
归舟
apps.short_description: 《Returning Board》 blends naval combat, light roguelite builds, and PvE extraction. Maneuver, aim, and fire. Scavenge gear and combine weapons, attachments, and cards. Keep searching or extract with your loot? Balance combat, cargo space, and risk on every voyage.

apps.name: 怪兽对战大师
apps.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.
